title: Width three clause block
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let a CNF formula on $n$ coordinates and a natural number $w$ be given, and choose a clause index $i$ in the formula. The width-three clause block is a list of DNF terms on $n+(w-3)c$ coordinates, where $c$ is the number of clauses; it is formed from the lifted literals of clause $i$ and the auxiliary literals assigned to that clause, using the Tseitin clause-term construction.
hypotheses_covered: Chosen clause index among the formula's clauses
caveat: The construction depends on the Tseitin clause chain, whose definition is not included in the supplied snippet.
